cells.gaps: No source names the standards body as a member of ISO or IEC, or says it belongs to neither. The one row is a transport ministry order requiring the API/PNR system to meet ISO/IEC 27001, a rule for one sector.
cells.note: The only row is Arrêté A/2026/419 requiring the national API/PNR passenger-data system to meet ISO/IEC 27001; a rule for one sector places nothing, so it sets no rung. Read as a rule on a government system, it would answer question 3 and stage 4.
